description: This file defines the UserDao interface for user data access operations in the Thingsboard project, including methods for saving, finding, and counting users based on various criteria.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Interface for user data access operations, including saving, retrieving, and counting users based on various filters.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a user object for a given tenant.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by tenant ID and email.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by tenant ID and email.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves users by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantAdmins
methods.description: Retrieves tenant admin users with pagination.

methods.name: findCustomerUsers
methods.description: Retrieves customer users by tenant and customer IDs with pagination.

methods.name: findUsersByCustomerIds
methods.description: Finds users for alarm assignment by tenant ID and list of customer IDs.

methods.name: findAllByAuthority
methods.description: Finds users by authority with pagination.

methods.name: findByAuthorityAndTenantsIds
methods.description: Finds users by authority and list of tenant IDs.

methods.name: findByAuthorityAndTenantProfilesIds
methods.description: Finds users by authority and list of tenant profile IDs.

methods.name: countTenantAdmins
methods.description: Counts the number of tenant admin users for a given tenant.

methods.name: findUserAuthDetailsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves user authentication details by tenant and user IDs.

methods.name: findUsersByTenantIdAndIds
methods.description: Finds users by tenant ID and list of user IDs.
